explication: scan4all is an automated multi-target security scanner. The main workflow accepts targets and scan options, performs port discovery, follows with HTTP probing and fingerprinting, then runs web checks and vulnerability tests before reporting findings. Other documented capabilities include subdomain enumeration, credential auditing, sensitive-file fuzzing, request-smuggling checks, crawler support, and configurable result storage. Source excerpts establish the startup, port-scan, event-dispatch, and selected PoC relationships; several additional branches are documented in the README but their wiring was not sampled.
